articles.title_en: Nobel Lecture: Financial Intermediaries and Financial Crises
Multiproduct Cost Pass-Through: Edgeworth’s Paradox Revisited
articles.title_cn: 多产品成本转嫁：埃奇沃思悖论再探
articles.abstract_en: Edgeworth’s paradox of taxation occurs when an increase in the unit cost of a product causes a multiproduct monopolist to reduce prices. We give simple illustrations of the paradox and a general analysis of the case of linear marginal cost and demand conditions, and we characterize which matrices of cost pass-through terms are consistent with profit maximization. When the firm supplies at least one pair of substitute products, we show how Edgeworth’s paradox always occurs with a suitable choice of cost function. We then establish a connection between Ramsey pricing and the paradox in a form relating to consumer surplus.
articles.abstract_cn: 埃奇沃思税收悖论发生在当一种产品的单位成本增加导致多产品垄断者降低价格时。我们给出了悖论的简单例证，并对线性边际成本和需求条件的情况进行了总体分析，同时刻画了哪些成本转嫁项矩阵与利润最大化一致。当企业至少供应一对替代产品时，我们展示了如何通过适当选择成本函数使埃奇沃思悖论总是出现。然后，我们建立了拉姆齐定价与悖论之间的一种联系，其形式涉及消费者剩余。

articles.title_en: Information Acquisition, Efficiency, and Nonfundamental Volatility
articles.title_cn: 信息获取、效率与非基本面波动
articles.abstract_en: We analyze efficiency and nonfundamental volatility in a class of generalized beauty-contest economies with endogenous information. As in models of rational-expectations equilibria, agents learn about exogenous states and endogenous aggregate actions. As in models of rational inattention, agents choose their information structures subject to a cost. We identify conditions on information costs that guarantee the existence of efficient or inefficient equilibria; we further identify conditions that guarantee the existence or nonexistence of equilibria with zero nonfundamental volatility. Mutual information, the cost typically assumed in rational-inattention models, guarantees the existence of an efficient equilibrium with zero nonfundamental volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一类具有内生信息的广义选美竞赛经济中分析效率与非基本面波动。与理性预期均衡模型一样，代理人学习外生状态和内生总体行动。与理性疏忽模型一样，代理人选择其信息结构并承担成本。我们识别了保证有效或无效均衡存在的信息成本条件；我们进一步识别了保证零非基本面波动均衡存在或不存在条件。互信息，即理性疏忽模型中通常假设的成本，保证了具有零非基本面波动的有效均衡的存在。

articles.title_en: Educational Attainment and Intergenerational Mobility: A Polygenic Score Analysis
articles.title_cn: 教育成就与代际流动性：一项多基因评分分析
articles.abstract_en: We extend a standard model of parental investment and intergenerational mobility to include a fully specified genetic analysis of skill transmission. The model’s predictions differ substantially from the standard model’s. The coefficient of intergenerational income elasticity (IGE) may be larger than that in the standard model and depends on the distribution of the genotype. The distribution of genetic endowments may be stratified according to income. The model is tested on data, including genetic information, of twins and their parents, estimating how IGE is affected by genetic factors and how environment and genes interact. The effect of intelligence is substantially stronger than that of other traits.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将父母投资与代际流动的标准模型扩展为包含技能传递的完全指定遗传分析。该模型的预测与标准模型有显著差异。代际收入弹性（IGE）系数可能大于标准模型中的系数，并且取决于基因型的分布。遗传禀赋的分布可能按收入分层。该模型在包含遗传信息的双胞胎及其父母的数据上进行检验，估计遗传因素如何影响IGE，以及环境与基因如何相互作用。智力的影响显著强于其他特质。

articles.title_en: Labor Market Conflict and the Decline of the Rust Belt
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场冲突与锈带地区的衰落
articles.abstract_en: No region of the United States fared worse over the postwar period than the Rust Belt. This paper analyzes how much of its decline can be accounted for by the persistent labor market conflict that characterized Rust Belt union-management relations. We develop a multisector, multiregion, dynamic general equilibrium model in which labor market conflict leads to strikes, wage premia, lower investment, and lower productivity growth. These lead to shrinking Rust Belt industries and to workers moving out of the Rust Belt. Labor conflict accounts for half of the decline in the region’s share of manufacturing employment. Foreign competition plays a smaller role, and its effects are concentrated after most of the region’s decline had already occurred.
articles.abstract_cn: 在战后时期，美国没有任何地区比锈带地区表现更差。本文分析了其衰落中有多少可归因于锈带地区工会与管理层关系中持续存在的劳动力市场冲突。我们构建了一个多部门、多区域、动态一般均衡模型，其中劳动力市场冲突导致罢工、工资溢价、投资下降和生产率增长放缓。这些因素导致锈带产业萎缩，工人迁出锈带地区。劳动力冲突解释了该地区制造业就业份额下降的一半。外国竞争的作用较小，且其影响集中在该地区大部分衰落已经发生之后。

articles.title_en: Sovereign Debt Ratchets and Welfare Destruction
articles.title_cn: 主权债务棘轮效应与福利破坏
articles.abstract_en: We study an impatient, risk-neutral government that cannot commit to a particular debt path, financed by competitive lenders. In equilibrium, debt adjusts slowly toward a debt-to-income target, exacerbating booms and busts. Strikingly, gains from trade dissipate when trading is continuous, leaving the government no better off than in financial autarky, owing to a sovereign “debt ratchet effect.” Moreover, citizens who are more patient than their government are strictly harmed. We characterize equilibrium debt dynamics, ergodics, and comparative statics when income follows a geometric Brownian motion and analyze devices that allow the sovereign to recapture gains from trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个缺乏耐心、风险中性的政府，它无法承诺特定的债务路径，由竞争性贷款人提供融资。在均衡中，债务缓慢地向债务收入比目标调整，加剧了繁荣与萧条。引人注目的是，当交易连续进行时，贸易收益会消散，使政府的情况并不比金融自给自足更好，这归因于主权“债务棘轮效应”。此外，比政府更有耐心的公民会受到严格损害。当收入遵循几何布朗运动时，我们刻画了均衡债务动态、遍历性及比较静态，并分析了允许主权国家重新获得贸易收益的机制。

articles.title_en: Multidimensional Premarital Investments with Imperfect Commitment
articles.title_cn: 多维婚前投资与不完全承诺
articles.abstract_en: We analyze premarital investments in human capital and housing when individuals are unable to make binding commitments to share their labor income with a prospective spouse. Investments are distorted if there are gender differences in bargaining power over own labor income or marriage market imbalances. Distortions are magnified when ex ante bargaining power favors one sex (e.g., women in China) and ex post bargaining power favors the other (e.g., men in China), since parents of boys will increase housing investments in order to credibly commit to share more resources with the boy’s potential wife, possibly crowding out human capital investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了当个体无法与未来配偶就分享劳动收入做出有约束力的承诺时，在人力资本和住房方面的婚前投资。如果性别在自身劳动收入的议价能力上存在差异或婚姻市场失衡，投资就会发生扭曲。当事前议价能力偏向某一性别（如中国的女性）而事后议价能力偏向另一性别（如中国的男性）时，扭曲会加剧，因为男孩的父母会增加住房投资，以可信地承诺与男孩的未来妻子分享更多资源，这可能会挤出人力资本投资。

articles.title_en: Incentives and Performance with Optimal Money Management Contracts
articles.title_cn: 最优资金管理合同中的激励与绩效
articles.abstract_en: I characterize the dynamics of incentives in an optimal contract with investment delegation, moral hazard, and uncertainty about the agent’s productivity. The principal increases the agent’s incentives after good performance in order to delegate more capital to an agent with higher perceived productivity, thus implementing a convex pay-for-performance scheme. Moreover, the principal commits to reduce the agent’s future incentives in order to mitigate ex ante investment distortions. Methodologically, I provide a duality-based strategy to overcome technical challenges common to continuous-time contracting models with state variables. I also derive a sufficient condition to verify the validity of the first-order approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 我刻画了在投资委托、道德风险和代理人生产率不确定性的最优合同中激励的动态特征。委托人在良好业绩后增加对代理人的激励，以便将更多资本委托给感知生产率较高的代理人，从而实施凸性的按绩效付费方案。此外，委托人承诺降低代理人未来的激励，以减轻事前投资扭曲。在方法论上，我提供了一种基于对偶的策略，以克服具有状态变量的连续时间契约模型中常见的技术挑战。我还推导了一个充分条件，以验证一阶方法的有效性。

articles.title_en: Minimum Wage and Individual Worker Productivity: Evidence from a Large US Retailer
articles.title_cn: 最低工资与个体工人生产率：来自美国大型零售商的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study workers who are employed by a large US retailer, work in many store locations, and are paid based on performance. By means of a border-discontinuity analysis, we document that workers become more productive and are terminated less often after a minimum wage increase. These effects are stronger among workers whose pay is more often supported by the minimum wage. However, when workers are monitored less intensely, the minimum wage depresses productivity. We interpret these findings through an efficiency wage model. After a minimum wage increase, profits decrease, and a calibration exercise suggests that worker welfare increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了受雇于一家美国大型零售商、在许多门店工作且按绩效计酬的工人。通过边界断点分析，我们记录了最低工资上调后工人生产率提高且被解雇的频率降低。这些效应在工资更常受最低工资支持的工人中更为显著。然而，当工人受到的监督强度较低时，最低工资会抑制生产率。我们通过效率工资模型来解释这些发现。最低工资上调后，利润下降，而校准练习表明工人福利增加。

articles.title_en: The Neolithic Agricultural Revolution and the Origins of Private Property
articles.title_cn: 新石器时代农业革命与私有财产起源
articles.abstract_en: Familiar explanations of why hunter-gatherers first took up farming—superior labor productivity, population pressure, or adverse climate—receive little support from recent evidence. Farming would be an unlikely choice without possession-based private property, which appears to have existed among rare groups of sedentary hunter-gatherers who became the first farmers. Our model shows that among them, farming could have benefited first adopters because private possession was more readily established and defended for cultivated crops and domesticated animals than for the diffuse wild resources on which hunter-gatherers relied, thus explaining how farming could have been introduced even without a productivity advantage.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于狩猎采集者为何首先从事农业的常见解释——优越的劳动生产力、人口压力或不利气候——很少得到近期证据的支持。如果没有基于占有的私有财产，农业将是一个不太可能的选择，而这种私有财产似乎存在于少数成为首批农民的定居狩猎采集者群体中。我们的模型表明，在他们中间，农业可能使首批采用者受益，因为对于栽培作物和驯养动物而言，私有占有比狩猎采集者所依赖的分散野生资源更容易建立和捍卫，从而解释了即使在没有生产力优势的情况下，农业是如何被引入的。

articles.title_en: The Effects of Fluoride in Drinking Water
articles.abstract_en: Water fluoridation is a common but debated public policy. In this paper, we use Swedish registry data to study the causal effects of fluoride in drinking water. We exploit exogenous variation in natural fluoride stemming from variation in geological characteristics at water sources to identify its effects. First, we reconfirm the long-established positive effect of fluoride on dental health. Second, we estimate a zero effect on cognitive ability in contrast to several recent debated epidemiological studies. Third, fluoride is furthermore found to increase labor income. This effect is foremost driven by individuals from a lower socioeconomic background.
articles.abstract_cn: 水氟化是一项常见但有争议的公共政策。在本文中，我们使用瑞典注册数据来研究饮用水中氟化物的因果效应。我们利用水源地质特征差异引起的天然氟外生变异来识别其影响。首先，我们再次确认了氟化物对牙齿健康的长期公认的积极影响。其次，与近期几项有争议的流行病学研究相反，我们估计氟化物对认知能力的影响为零。第三，还发现氟化物能增加劳动收入。这一效应主要由来自较低社会经济背景的个体驱动。

articles.abstract_en: Growth in this model is driven by technological change that arises from intentional investment decisions made by profit-maximizing agents. The distinguishing feature of the technology as an input is that it is neither a conventional good nor a public good; it is a nonrival, partially excludable good. Because of the nonconvexity introduced by a nonrival good, price-taking competition cannot be supported. Instead, the equilibrium is one with monopolistic competition. The main conclusions are that the stock of human capital determines the rate of growth, that too little human capital is devoted to research in equilibrium, that integration into world markets will increase growth rates, and that having a large population is not sufficient to generate growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 该模型中的增长由技术变革驱动，而技术变革源于利润最大化主体的有意投资决策。技术作为投入品的显著特征在于，它既非传统商品，也非公共物品；它是一种非竞争性、部分排他性的商品。由于非竞争性商品引入的非凸性，价格接受竞争无法维持。相反，均衡是垄断竞争下的均衡。主要结论是：人力资本存量决定增长率；均衡中投入研究的人力资本过少；融入世界市场将提高增长率；拥有大量人口并不足以产生增长。

articles.title_en: Robots and Jobs: Evidence from US Labor Markets
articles.title_cn: 机器人与就业：来自美国劳动力市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of industrial robots on US labor markets. We show theoretically that robots may reduce employment and wages and that their local impacts can be estimated using variation in exposure to robots—defined from industry-level advances in robotics and local industry employment. We estimate robust negative effects of robots on employment and wages across commuting zones. We also show that areas most exposed to robots after 1990 do not exhibit any differential trends before then, and robots’ impact is distinct from other capital and technologies. One more robot per thousand workers reduces the employment-to-population ratio by 0.2 percentage points and wages by 0.42%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了工业机器人对美国劳动力市场的影响。我们从理论上表明，机器人可能会减少就业和工资，并且其局部影响可以通过机器人暴露度的差异来估计——该暴露度由行业层面的机器人技术进步和当地行业就业情况定义。我们估计了机器人对通勤区就业和工资的稳健负效应。我们还表明，在1990之后机器人暴露度最高的地区在此之前并未表现出任何差异趋势，并且机器人的影响与其他资本和技术不同。每千名工人增加一个机器人，就业人口比下降0.2个百分点，工资下降0.42%。

articles.title_en: The Pricing of Options and Corporate Liabilities
articles.abstract_en: If options are correctly priced in the market, it should not be possible to make sure profits by creating portfolios of long and short positions in options and their underlying stocks. Using this principle, a theoretical valuation formula for options is derived. Since almost all corporate liabilities can be viewed as combinations of options, the formula and the analysis that led to it are also applicable to corporate liabilities such as common stock, corporate bonds, and warrants. In particular, the formula can be used to derive the discount that should be applied to a corporate bond because of the possibility of default.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果期权在市场上被正确定价，那么通过构建期权及其标的股票的多头和空头头寸组合来确保利润应该是不可能的。利用这一原则，推导出了期权的理论估值公式。由于几乎所有公司负债都可以被视为期权的组合，该公式及其分析也适用于诸如普通股、公司债券和认股权证等公司负债。特别是，该公式可用于推导因违约可能性而应对公司债券应用的折价。
